news.headline: Meerkats Can Find Their Way Home All by Themselves
news.body: Scientists in Switzerland put GPS collars on 20 meerkats in Africa's Kalahari Desert and carried them about 1.5 kilometers from their group. Eighteen of the 20 walked back home alone, and even young meerkats made it. They seem to use their eyes and noses to find their friends.

news.headline: Voyager 1 Is Now One Light-Day Away From Earth
news.body: NASA's Voyager 1 is the farthest spacecraft ever flown. On Nov. 18 it reached one light-day from Earth, about 16.1 billion miles away. That means a radio message from home takes a whole day to reach it, after more than 49 years of travel!

fun_fact: Meerkats take turns standing guard on their back legs to watch for danger! 🦡

word_of_the_day.sentence: Voyager 1 has traveled an amazing distance from Earth.

did_you_know: Light from the Sun takes about 8 minutes to reach Earth, but Voyager 1 is a whole day away! ☀️
